notes: Chandra HETG spectroscopy of NGC 1275 in Perseus cluster constraining ALP-photon coupling via X-ray transparency (photon-ALP conversion in ICM magnetic field). 99.7% credible region: g_agamma < 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 (Model-A) and < 7.9e-13 GeV^-1 (Model-B) for m_a < 1e-12 eV. This is an astrophysical/conversion bound, not a DM haloscope, so no DM density assumed. Limit is essentially flat for masses below ~1e-12 eV; I report the conservative Model-B value. Note paper quotes 99.7% (3-sigma) limit; the 95% region picks out preferred nonzero coupling attributed to calibration. | Vision: Traced lower boundary of the HETG (99.7% excl.) constraint region in image 1. Plateau at ~6.3e-13 GeV^-1 for low masses, rising near m_a ~ 1e-10 eV. Deep dip near 1e-10 eV. Y-axis log scale 1e-13 to 2e-11. SN1987A and M87 lines also shown but HETG is the strongest (lowest) constraint. | Calibration: No calibration needed
